goals: Provide project-neutral local orchestration infrastructure for AI-assisted development across multiple Git repositories.
Support continuous autonomous lifecycles across PLAN, EXECUTE, REVIEW, and REMEDIATE phases with independent review verification.
Enable durable, conversation-independent project context injection into Planner, Worker, and Reviewer prompts.
architecture: src/dev_orchestrator/config.py loads and canonically normalizes multi-project configuration and context declarations.
src/dev_orchestrator/daemon.py runs the unified single-process daemon combining monitor loop, web dashboard, and browser bridge.
src/dev_orchestrator/core/project_context.py validates, resolves, and deterministically renders durable project context.
src/dev_orchestrator/core/transition_executor.py manages Worker execution, ledger persistence, and remediation routing.
src/dev_orchestrator/core/ai_planner.py coordinates AI planning and independent plan review, freezing accepted designs into agent/next.md.
src/dev_orchestrator/core/ai_reviewer.py executes independent AI code reviews of completed Worker tasks.
src/dev_orchestrator/ai/execution_port.py and aibroker_subprocess.py integrate with AIResourceBroker over subprocess CLI.
src/dev_orchestrator/core/progress.py provides deduplicated, non-model progress notifications to browser and status channels.
protected_scope: Stable controller worktree at C:\work\github\DevOrchestrator is strictly read-only and must never be modified, stopped, restarted, or replaced by Workers.
Physical laboratory and hardware automation interfaces remain outside generic orchestration authority.
Sensitive credentials and private authorization headers must never be committed to repository files or injected into prompts.
safety_constraints: Always fail closed on configuration invalidity, repository truth mismatch, or corrupted project context.
Strict project isolation: paths must not escape repository boundaries and context is strictly project-scoped.
Only one DevOrchestrator daemon may run per computer at any given time.
Independent review authority: reviewer must operate independently of planner and worker models.
Clean repository required before planning or launching Workers.
runtime_assumptions: Windows operating system with PowerShell and Git installed.
Python 3.11+ environment with UTF-8 encoding enabled.
AIResourceBroker running locally on port 8875 when aibroker execution engine is selected.
DevOrchestrator daemon runs dashboard on port 8770 and Browser Bridge on port 8765 by default.
key_decisions: D1 architecture: Unified single daemon process per host hosting monitor, dashboard, and browser bridge.
Continuous lifecycle routing across PLAN, EXECUTE, REVIEW, and REMEDIATE states via stateful ledgers.
Broker-native running state projection directly reflecting active planner, worker, and reviewer dispatches.
Transport-only progress channel emitting milestone notifications without consuming model inference quota.
Durable project context foundation with declared-authoritative repository precedence and optional supplemental input.
Graphify remains an optional external tool and is never imported, required, or executed at runtime by DevOrchestrator.
